accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by SOCPA (listed companies from FY2017, all others FY2018; IFRS for SMEs endorsed as an option). Statutory ZATCA/Ministry of Commerce filings in Arabic; SOCPA maintains the official Arabic IFRS translation.

default_tax_line.label: Zakat and Income Tax
default_tax_line.basis: Default assumes a fully Saudi/GCC-owned company: Zakat approximated at 2.5% of EBT (statutory Zakat is 2.5% of the Zakat BASE for a Hijri year - a net-assets-based formula under MR 1007/2024; the profit component stays at 2.5% while the prorated ~2.5778% applies to the non-profit base component for Gregorian years; %-of-EBT is a floor-level proxy).

tax_recipes.mixed_ownership: Blend by ownership: tax_pct_ebt = 0.20 * foreign_share + 0.025 * saudi_gcc_share. The 20% leg is CIT on the non-Saudi/GCC share of taxable income; oil/hydrocarbon producers instead pay 50-85% tiered by capital investment.
tax_recipes.pillar_two: No GloBE/DMTT enacted as of mid-2026 (new Income Tax Law still draft); revisit if the entity is in a >= EUR 750m group.

label_overrides.14: Zakat & Tax Rate (% of Earnings Before Tax)
label_overrides.35: Earnings Before Zakat and Income Tax

vat_note: VAT 15% since July 2020 (registration threshold SAR 375,000). Not a P&L line here; AR/AP balances may be VAT-inclusive. FATOORA e-invoicing integration effectively universal since mid-2026.
fiscal_year_note: Gregorian or Hijri fiscal years permitted; Zakat/CIT return due within 120 days of year end. SAR pegged at 3.75/USD.
depreciation_note: Tax depreciation (Income Tax Law Art 17) uses five declining-balance pools: buildings 5%; industrial/agricultural movable assets 10%; computers/software 25%; geological survey/exploration expenses 20%; all other 10%; with the 50/50 addition-year rule.
disclosure: The 'Zakat and Income Tax' line is modeled as an effective rate on earnings before tax. Statutory Zakat is computed on the Zakat base (net-assets formula under MR 1007/2024), not on profit - the %-of-EBT treatment is a simplification that can misstate the charge for asset-heavy or leveraged entities; mixed-ownership entities owe blended Zakat + CIT. Not tax or Zakat advice.
